condition: Dent diameter < 25mm AND depth < 1mm AND no cracks radiating from dent
action: Defer up to 10 days, log in tech log, monitor at next A-check

condition: Dent diameter 25-50mm AND depth < 2mm AND no cracks AND not in pressurized critical area
action: Repair within 72 hours; apply temporary skin patch per SRM 53-10
operational_limit: Reduced cruise altitude may be required pending engineering review

condition: Any dent with visible crack propagation OR dent in pressurized fuselage with depth > 2mm
action: Aircraft no-go. Permanent structural repair required before next flight per SRM
operational_limit: Grounded until repaired and signed off

item_name: Single missing rivet in non-critical area
condition: Single rivet missing AND not in primary load path AND adjacent fasteners intact
action: Defer up to 10 days; replace at next scheduled maintenance opportunity
operational_limit: Visual inspection required at each transit check

item_name: Missing fastener cluster (3 or more adjacent)
condition: Three or more adjacent fasteners missing OR fasteners missing along a primary load path
action: Aircraft no-go. Restore fastener integrity per SRM before next flight

item_name: Loose or damaged rivet (head deformed or proud)
condition: Rivet head deformed, proud, or smoking AND no crack in surrounding skin
action: Replace within 72 hours; inspect surrounding skin for fatigue indications

condition: Any complete penetration of the fuselage skin
action: Aircraft no-go. Structural repair per SRM 53-10 required; engineering disposition mandatory

item_name: Tear at panel edge or skin lap joint
condition: Tear or rupture initiated at a panel edge, lap joint, or stringer attachment
action: Aircraft no-go. Stop-drill and permanent repair required per SRM

condition: Damaged or loose fastener on door structure AND door seal not compromised
action: Repair within 72 hours; verify door rigging and pressurization seal after repair
operational_limit: Confirm door fully latched and locked indications before each flight

item_name: Flight compartment window frame fastener damage
condition: Any damaged or missing fastener on a flight compartment window frame
action: Aircraft no-go. Restore fastener integrity and pressure-test before next flight

condition: Dent diameter < 25mm AND depth < 1mm AND not over fuel tank boundary
action: Defer up to 10 days; smooth-blend per SRM 57-50 at next opportunity
operational_limit: Visual inspection at each daily check

condition: Dent on nacelle outer skin AND not interfering with engine cowling latches AND no inlet airflow disturbance
action: Repair within 72 hours; inspect cowling fit and engine inlet for FOD

condition: Dent diameter < 30mm AND depth < 1mm AND not on leading edge
action: Defer up to 10 days; cosmetic repair at next scheduled visit

item_name: Existing repair patch showing edge wear
condition: Previously repaired area showing minor edge wear AND no lift / debond AND no surrounding cracks
action: Defer up to 10 days with monitoring; touch-up sealant and re-inspect at next A-check

condition: Surface scratch AND no skin penetration AND depth within paint thickness
action: Defer up to 120 days; cosmetic touch-up at next scheduled paint cycle
